title: sorbus ambigua
intro: Sorbus ambigua, commonly known as Chinese rowan or Manchurian mountain ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to northeastern China and Korea. It is valued for its edible fruit and potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus ambigua are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antioxidant activity, and display anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
